BiblicalUsage: Saul eyed David from that day forward — watched him with jealous suspicion after the women sang David's praise above his own. One look, and a king's heart turned.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe jealousy starts in the eye, and Saul is my warning that watching a rival too closely can rot a whole reign.
